caption:
Too much on your plate this morning?

Allah tells us to put our trust in Him, and that He is enough as a Disposer of affairs. Plan well, work hard, and leave the outcome with Him.

Surah Al-Ahzaab 33:3

Pick one task today and begin it with Bismillah.

#tawakkul #trustinallah #morningreminder #quranreels

Recitation: Maher Al-Muaiqly
